Student leaves plain-eyed about three traps and holding a Quality Gate that checks them; it hands the M2 first-move search a filter without picking the move. Trace phase 1 mood 8, close 8. Teaching beats only; no setup beat scored. Closest to a 7: L5-11 read tidy; not below the floor.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Epistemic mood ≠ punitive mood.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Unease, where present, is not-knowing: L9 "people who have not used agents cannot tell you what they need". Closest to punitive: L15 "It feels like leadership because it is visible and measurable" and L23 "It feels like the ambition the transformation asked for" name why the move tempts, not a fault in the reader; nothing says "you did wrong".

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Lead with discipline, not failure mode.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Sections lead with the discipline: L5 "Competence before platform", L13 "Pull, not mandate", L21 "Hybrid from day one"; each names the tempting move as the negative case in its first line. Closest: H1 L1 "Three moves that *backfire*" is failure-named, but it names a consequence of moves rather than a person's failure and the discipline lead sits at header/body level, which the rule accepts (rule question: does a lecture title count as a Big Idea? Title words are not shame words).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Strategy-fidelity check.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Strategy fidelity: facets checked. Front-run: doc says the three land in M1 before any first move (Three things NOT to do); no M-number or module-name refs (grep 0); L19 "Your part is the conditions" gestures at the conditions-creator theme the doc places in M3-M5 but names no mechanism and uses no term. Arc: after install, before the weekly diagnostic; opens the M2 search without answering it. Big Idea/mood: doc M1 mood diagnostic directness honoured. Mood not resolved early: no first move chosen, no cross-module teaching moment spent.
